environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user. The Flask app listens on port 8080, fronted by an nginx reverse proxy on port 443 with TLS termination. No request body inspection or filtering is configured on nginx (simple proxy_pass). The container/host has wkhtmltopdf installed, and the webapp user has standard shell access (/bin/bash). Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No AppArmor or SELinux enforcement (permissive mode). The process runs with default Linux capabilities.

config.nginx: proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080 with no body filtering
